doc.summary: Mermaid graph renderer with intelligent pruning.
doc.description:
Converts the internal Node/Edge graph into a Mermaid flowchart
(string) suitable for embedding in Markdown. Handles node limits,
deduplication, CSS-like class styling, internal import edges, and
community subgraphs.

doc.summary: Renders a knowledge graph to Mermaid JS flowchart syntax.
doc.description:
Nodes are ordered by import count and symbol richness; the top
``max_nodes`` entries are included. External dependencies appear
as dashed boxes. Internal import edges are solid arrows.
Community subgraphs group related files when analysis is available.

name: __init__
signature: def __init__(self, max_nodes: int = 300, max_symbols_per_file: int = 5, module_style: str = 'fill:#1e1e1e,stroke:#ff6666,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff', class_style: str = 'fill:#2d2d2d,stroke:#4ec9b0,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff', function_style: str = 'fill:#333,stroke:#dcdcaa,stroke-width:1px,color:#dcdcaa', external_style: str = 'fill:#111,stroke:#666,stroke-dasharray:5 5,color:#aaa', internal_edge_style: str = 'stroke:#88aaff,stroke-width:1px', max_edges: int = 480, max_internal_edges: int = 100, grid_columns: int = 6, max_externals: int = 24, direction: str = 'LR') -> None

params.name: max_edges
params.description: Total edge budget; Mermaid refuses to render more than 500 edges, so the default stays below that hard limit.

params.name: grid_columns
params.description:
Files per row inside a community; invisible links
stack the rest below, so the map never collapses into one
extremely wide row.

params.name: max_externals
params.description: Maximum external import boxes (each one is a node Mermaid lays out in the same rank).

params.name: direction
params.description: Mermaid direction; LR stacks unrelated nodes vertically.

name: render
signature: def render(self, nodes: List[Node], edges: List[Edge], resolved_edges: Optional[List[Edge]] = None, analysis: Optional[AnalysisResult] = None) -> Tuple[str, bool]

doc.summary: Produce a Mermaid flowchart string and a truncation flag.
doc.description:
Nodes are sorted by import popularity, then by symbol count.
Internal import edges (between project files) are rendered as
solid arrows when *resolved_edges* is provided. Community
subgraphs wrap related files when *analysis* is given.

returns.description: Tuple of (Mermaid source string, is_truncated bool).
